prompt:
Theme: backlit night alley

Subject:
A cinematic portrait of a woman in her 20s standing close to the camera in a dark, narrow night alley, shot vertically from an extremely low angle to just above the thighs. The woman occupies a large portion of the center to the right side of the frame. Her head is tilted up as she looks down at the camera.

Characters/Expressions:
A small, slightly long face, warm beige skin, thin dark brown eyebrows, slender brown eyes, thick eyeliner and long eyelashes, flushed pale red cheeks, and glossy coral-rose lips. A strong, calm expression. Her dark brown hair has wet strands falling across her forehead, blowing to the left. Backlight edges each strand in gold.

Clothing/Pose:
off-white fine ribbed short-sleeved top. The deep V-neckline is edged with thin lace. She wears a high-waisted pleated mini skirt with a gray, brown, and black checkered pattern. The low camera angle emphasizes the perspective of the legs.

Background/Light:
A metal shutter on the right reflects warm light. The background is a very dark alley with blurred outlines of buildings. A strong platinum-white backlight source is behind her head. Amber fill light illuminates the front of her face and torso.

Composition/Camera:
Vertical 3:4, close-up fashion portrait from a ground-level low angle. The wide-angle perspective makes the foreground larger, converging the upper body into the distance. Focus is sharp on the eyes and face while background lights have large circular bokeh.

Texture/Style:
High-resolution realistic nighttime fashion photography. Combines amber and platinum-white backlighting with deep blue-black shadows. Precise skin texture, hair detail, and fabric weaving. Cinematic finish balancing power and silence.

Negative:
Avoid facial distortion, extra fingers, arm/leg deformation, unnatural skirt movement, perspective breakdown, or contradictory lighting.
